hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file_path" in */internal/commands/generated/*) echo 'BLOCK: generated file — run make generate instead' >&2; exit 2;; esac
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file_path" in *.go) gofumpt -w "$file_path" || echo 'WARN: gofumpt failed' >&2;; esac
